$comment: The 1.35 names core-next does not ship yet, each with its layer (lib/layers.ts layerOfExport). Hand-maintained, never generated, and tighten-only: remove a name when core-next ships it, in the same engine PR (owner, 2026-11-17: "Route B: approve the rule (Recommended)"); lib/guard.ts lets an engine PR change this file only by pure removal. The core-next surface gate (contracts/lib/next-surface.ts) accepts a missing 1.35 name only if it is listed here and its layer is above layers.rules.json `current`; a missing name not listed fails at any layer, a listed name core-next ships fails as stale, and a listed name whose layer is built fails. This file is in harness.lock.json: changing it needs the oracle-change label.
